name: fee-flow-buy
description: Buyback & burn (JazzFeeFlow): take the whole fee basket (the named tokens) for the current price in $JAZZ, which is burned from your wallet. Approves exactly maxPayment $JAZZ to JazzFeeFlow first. No owner, no withdraw path.

inputs.name: assets
inputs.description: Tokens to take, their whole balances in JazzFeeFlow (0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 = ETH). $JAZZ is never for sale.

inputs.name: assetsReceiver
inputs.description: Where the basket goes (usually your own wallet).

inputs.name: epochId
inputs.description: The epoch you priced, from fee-flow-epoch: a bid never lands in a later epoch.

inputs.name: deadline
inputs.description: Last unix second the bid is valid.

inputs.name: maxPayment
inputs.description: The most $JAZZ you will burn, in base units (18 decimals). Exactly this much is approved.
